title: Harness kill-guard: protect live wkappbot processes
desc: Blocks Stop-Process/taskkill targeting live wkappbot processes (wkappbot-core, wkchat, wka11y, wkappbot) -- these are active CLI sessions; killing them destroys running conversations. Route through wkappbot taskkill which classifies before killing.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when a PowerShell Stop-Process/Kill-Process or taskkill names a wkappbot process. Direct OS-level kill of these is forbidden without classification.

FIX: classify first -- wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe --dry-run shows PROTECTED/ZOMBIE/UNKNOWN with no kill. To force-kill a genuine zombie: wkappbot taskkill --force <pid>. For lifecycle cleanup use wkappbot --sudo eye restart.
WHY: wkappbot-core/wkchat/wka11y host the user's active AI sessions; a blind kill loses their work. The AI WORK process set is also spared from emergency reaping. See: wkappbot-taskkill-usage.
author: claude
